verses.sanskrit: वातस्योपक्रमः स्नेहः स्वेदः संशोधनं मृदु । स्वाद्वम्ललवणोष्णानि भोज्यान्यभ्यङ्गमर्दनम् ॥१॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: वेष्टनं त्रासनं सेको मद्यं पैष्टिकगौडिकम् । स्निग्धोष्णा वस्तयो वस्तिनियमः सुखशीलता ॥२॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: दीपनैः पाचनैः सिद्धाः स्नेहाश्चानेकयोनयः । विशेषान्मेद्यपिशितरसतैलानुवासनम् ॥३॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: पित्तस्य सर्पिषः पानं स्वादुशीतैर्विरेचनम् । स्वादुतिक्तकषायाणि भोजनान्यौषधानि च ॥४॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: सुगन्धिशीतहृद्यानां गन्धानामुपसेवनम् । कण्ठेगुणानां हाराणां मणीनामुरसा धृतिः ॥५॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: कर्पूरचन्दनोशीरैरनुलेपः क्षणे क्षणे । प्रदोषश्चन्द्रमाः सौधं हारि गीतं हिमोऽनिलः ॥६॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: अयन्त्रणसुखं मित्रं पुत्रः सन्दिग्धमुग्धवाक् । छन्दानुवर्तिनो दाराः प्रियाः शीलविभूषिताः ॥७॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: शीताम्बुधारागर्भाणि गृहाण्युद्यानदीर्घिकाः । सुतीर्थविपुलस्वच्छसलिलाशयसैकते ॥८॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: साम्भोजजलतीरान्ते कायमाने द्रुमाकुले । सौम्या भावाः पयः सर्पिर्विरेकश्च विशेषतः ॥९॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: श्लेष्मणो विधिना युक्तं तीक्ष्णं वमनरेचनम् । अन्नं रूक्षाल्पतीक्ष्णोष्णं कटुतिक्तकषायकम् ॥१०॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: दीर्घकालस्थितं मद्यं रतिः प्रीतिः प्रजागरः । अनेक रूपो व्यायामश्चिन्ता रूक्षं विमर्दनम् ॥११॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: विशेषाद्वमनं यूषः क्षौद्रं मेद्घ्नमौषधम् । धूमोपवासगण्डूषा निःसुखत्वं सुखाय च ॥१२॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: उपक्रमः पृथग्दोषान् योऽयमुद्दिश्य कीर्तितः । संसर्गसन्निपातेषु तं यथास्वं विकल्पयेत् ॥१३॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रैष्मः प्रायो मरुत्पित्ते वासन्तः कफमारुते । मरुतो योगवाहित्वात्कफपित्ते तु शारदः ॥१४॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: चय एव जयेद्दोषं कुपितं त्वविरोधयन् । सर्वकोपे बलीयांसं शेषदोषाविरोधतः ॥१५॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: प्रयोगः शमयेद्व्याधिमेकं योऽन्यमुदीरयेत् । नासौ विशुद्धः शुद्धस्तु शमयेद्यो न कोपयेत् ॥१६॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: व्यायामादूष्मणस्तैक्ष्ण्यादहिताचरणादपि । कोष्ठाच्छाखास्थिमर्माणि द्रुतत्वान्मारुतस्य च ॥१७॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: दोषा यान्ति तथा तेभ्यः स्रोतोमुखविशोधनात् । वृद्ध्याऽभिष्यन्दनात्पाकात्कोष्ठं वायोश्च निग्रहात् ॥१८॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रस्थाश्च विलम्बेरन् भूयो हेतुप्रतीक्षिणः । ते कालादिबलं लब्ध्वा कुप्यन्त्यन्याश्रयेष्वपि ॥१९॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: तत्रान्यस्थानसंस्थेषु तदीयामबलेषु तु । कुर्याच्चिकित्सां स्वामेव बलेनान्याभिभाविषु ॥२०॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: आगन्तुं शमयेद्दोषं स्थानिनं प्रतिकृत्य वा । प्रायस्तिर्यग्गता दोषाः क्लेशयन्त्यातुरांश्चिरम् ॥२१॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: कुर्यान्न तेषु त्वरया देहाग्निबलवित् क्रियाम् । शमयेत्तान्प्रयोगेण सुखं वा कोष्ठमानयेत् ॥२२॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा कोष्ठप्रपन्नांश्च यथासन्नं विनिर्हरेत् । स्रोतोरोधबलभ्रंशगौरवानिलमूढताः ॥२३॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: आलस्यापक्तिनिष्ठीवमलसङ्गारुचिक्लमाः । लिङ्गं मलानां सामानां निरामाणां विपर्ययः ॥२४॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: ऊष्मणोऽल्पबलत्वेन धातुमाद्यमपाचितम् । दुष्टमामाशयगतं रसमामं प्रचक्षते ॥२५॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: अन्ये दोषेभ्य एवातिदुष्टेभ्योऽन्योन्यमूर्च्छनात् । कोद्रवेभ्यो विषस्येव वदन्त्यामस्य सम्भवम् ॥२६॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: आमेन तेन सम्पृक्ता दोषा दूष्याश्च दूषिताः । सामा इत्युपदिश्यन्ते ये च रोगास्तदुद्भवाः ॥२७॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदेहप्रविसृतान्सामान्दोषान्न निर्हरेत् । लीनान्धातुष्वनुत्क्लिष्टान्फलादामाद्रसानिव ॥२८॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: आश्रयस्य हि नाशाय ते स्युर्दुर्निहरतत्त्वतः । पाचनैर्दीपनैः स्नेहैः स्वेदैश्च परिष्कृतान् ॥२९॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: शोधयेच्छोधनैः काले यथासन्नं यथाबलम् । हन्त्याशु युक्तं वक्त्रेण द्रव्यमामाशयान्मलान् ॥३०॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: घ्राणेन चोर्ध्वजत्रूत्थान्पक्वाधानाद्गुदेन च । उत्क्लिष्टानध ऊर्ध्वं वा न चामान्वहतः स्वयम् ॥३१॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: धारयेदौषधैर्दोषान्विधृतास्ते हि रोगदाः । प्रवृत्तान्प्रागतो दोषानुपेक्षेत हिताशिनः ॥३२॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: विबद्धान्पाचनैस्तैस्तैः पाचयेन्निर्हरेत वा । श्रावणे कार्त्तिके चैत्रे मासि साधारणे क्रमात् ॥३३॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रीष्मवर्षाहिमचितान्वाय्वादीनाशु निर्हरेत् । अत्युष्णवर्षशीता हि ग्रीष्मवर्षाहिमागमाः ॥३४॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: सन्धौ साधारणे तेषां दुष्टान्दोषान्विशोधयेत् । स्वस्थवृत्तमभिप्रेत्य व्याधौ व्याधिवशेन तु ॥३५॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वा शीतोष्णवृष्टीनां प्रतीकारं यथायथम् । प्रयोजयेत्क्रियां प्राप्तां क्रियाकालं न हापयेत् ॥३६॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: युञ्ज्यादनन्नमन्नादौ मध्येऽन्ते कवडान्तरे । ग्रासे ग्रासे मुहुः सान्नं सामुद्गं निशि चौषधम् ॥३७॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: कफोद्रेके गदेऽनन्नं बलिनो रोगरोगिणोः । अन्नादौ विगुणेऽपाने समाने मध्य इष्यते ॥३८॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: व्यानेऽन्ते प्रातराशस्य सायमाशस्य तूत्तरे । ग्रासग्रासान्तयोः प्राणे प्रदुष्टे मातरिश्वनि ॥३९॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: मुहुर्मुहुर्विषच्छर्दिहिध्मातृट्श्वासकासिषु । योज्यं सभोज्यं भैषज्यं भोज्यैश्चित्रैररोचके ॥४०॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.

verses.sanskrit: कम्पाक्षेपकहिध्मासु सामुद्गं लघुभोजिनाम् । ऊर्ध्वजत्रुविकारेषु स्वप्नकाले प्रशस्यते ॥४१॥
verses.student_meaning: This verse presents a classical principle of dosha treatment, Ama management, seasonal purification, or medicine-administration timing as applicable to its section.
